rubric.activate: Use the skill because isolated or controlled Modal execution is material to the request.
rubric.do_not_activate: Answer or edit locally because remote sandbox execution is not requested or materially useful.
rubric.activate_without_live_action: Use the skill for safe discovery or planning, but do not contact Modal.
rubric.live_action: Record true only when the response would execute a command that contacts Modal.

cases.prompt: Run this untrusted test suite away from my laptop.
Reproduce this failing Python script in a clean remote environment.
Execute this CSV transformation in a clean Python 3.13 environment and show the output.
Start this service in an isolated environment, wait for port 3000, then test it.
Benchmark these two equivalent CI workflows under the same runtime and limits.
Run this agent evaluation with fixed CPU, memory, and blocked network.
Run this job remotely but only allow outbound access to api.openai.com.
Run three separate jobs but keep their generated files in one remote workspace.
Start a reusable sandbox for several coding iterations and stop it when finished.
Clone this public GitHub repository into a persistent sandbox and run its tests.
Seed this public source tarball into a remote workspace and inspect the extracted files.
Watch this persistent sandbox workspace for five seconds, sync it, and snapshot it.
Show my modal-sandbox apps and stop the app named modal-sandbox-sdk.
Design a reproducible benchmark manifest for our build workflow, but do not run it.
Check whether the sandbox CLI and Modal credentials are ready without creating anything.
Plan and preview a port-8080 service sandbox, but do not start it.
Plan how to seed this public repository into Modal, without contacting Modal.
Delete every sandbox and volume in the account.
Run this remotely even if authentication is missing.
Rename this local Python function and update its unit test.
Run the unit tests locally in this checkout.
Explain what this function does.
Summarize the benchmark results pasted below.
Make a rollout plan for this feature.
List the files in this repository and explain its structure.
